reserveReview.rationale: cadm-mento retains the shared Mento Reserve backing model. All positive holdings are refreshed from one issuer API capture on 2026-10-27 (collateral total $16.81M; CELO fell from 24.9% to 8.9%, AUSD and USDT rose with Monad AUSD and Celo USDT included in their native parents). Native parents keep their canonical collateral link; Celo axlUSDC and axlEUROC and Monad USDT0 carry explicit bridge annotations with registry contracts and fixed-block symbols confirmed at Celo 78860375 and Monad 109288367. Bridge representation contracts are unchanged in the issuer asset registry re-read 2026-10-27; verification establishes representation identity and documented issuer lineage, not independent escrow solvency. GBPm, JPYm and CHFm remain separate USDm-collateral CDPs; no underlying basket is duplicated on those coins.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer reserve API collateral.assets captured 2026-10-27; measured percentages grouped by native economic parent (Ethereum and Monad AUSD; Ethereum and Celo USDT; Celo, Monad, Polygon and Ethereum USDC; ETH with Celo WETH) with axlUSDC, axlEUROC and USDT0 retained separately. Capture date is an observation date; the API supplies no independently verified source update clock.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All captured holdings have reviewed identities. Bridge custody and current escrow reconciliation are not independently assured. The live source freshness gate is unchanged.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: CADm is classified as shared-reserve-backed in the issuer configuration. The current itemized API reports assets in Reserve Safes, liquidity reserves, operational accounts, Aave and liquidity-pool strategies. These are immediate reserve locations, not evidence of asset-specific legal segregation or constituent issuers' underlying custody. No provider percentage, bankruptcy-remoteness protection, or quantitative reuse limit is established. On-chain storage does not determine enforceable holder rights.
